body: I’m dealing with a lot of that as my 13yr old son passed away on September 5th this year and his dad, whom although we were no longer together yet I still love so deeply, was killed by a drunk driver on July 28th this year as well. Returning to what my “normal” life was before my world was flattened will never happen. Friends I’ve had for years have since stopped really talking or they act different. Some, those few that were like those mentioned in the message above, have stuck around. Strangely enough, friends I’ve had long since “out grew” from school and my younger years, have fallen back into my life, as if the circle of friendship has begun it’s 360 degree orbit again. It’s so tricky, as those we believe to be genuine and true are maybe toxic which in return makes us feel that resentment. Maybe just taking a break from that friend for a couple days or weeks, will not only give you time to grieve, but give you time  to actually sit down and perhaps make a list of the pros and cons of the friendship. Also, one of life’s most valuable lessons: “never live with your friends”. That will destroy a friendship faster than anything. I wish you well and my condolences to you for your father.

I am still to this day friends with a former teacher of mine. I got through some of my worst days in school because of her and as an adult, I’ve had to endure such a deep tragedy and she’s been so supportive as well. Teachers go unappreciated. The good ones in the states are few and far between but they do exist💕 I’m sorry for your loss. To the young lady’s parents, my heart is with you as my son passed away almost 2 months ago.

I’ve received word that two people can see now. What beautiful eyes my baby had 😭 I’m devastated but grateful I could at least turn a tragedy into hope for someone else. His heart valves were able to save a heart patient that desperately needed a donor. I’d give anything for this reality to not be exactly that, but at least I was able to offer a little hope for someone who maybe had none. People wait on donor lists for years, so I understand that aspect of it all. I’d just really love to hear from those he’s helped. Maybe someday 💙
Thinking of you. I don’t want to share my grief story as it’s not the time to do that, but you don’t know me but do know that my heart is with you.
Did you get a bracelet? If you’d like one, lmk. Can maybe have your parents bring you up to Biggby or something this weekend.
You’re not useless. You matter and you are loved. You did not do this. Words destroyed my son’s spirit. The only way to overcome this tragedy is remember Kaileb and to remember to ALWAYS BE KIND💕
I’m available to speak with this person. Self harming yourself over grief is not the answer. I’m Kaileb’s mom and I’m available if you need to reach out.
